repos_data.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
Your project is scattered across too many tools. Map the chaos on an infinite canvas where notes, files, TO-DOs (and more!) finally live together.
Mindmapping made simple: Host and create your own mindmaps. Share your mindmap sessions with your team and collaborate on mindmaps.
Brainstorm, organize, and prioritize ideas effortlessly. Use it as a collaborative planning board or for live brainstormings within your team.

One model's answer sounds confident even when it's wrong. brainstorm-mcp runs multi-round debates between GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude and local Ollama models, then returns a structured synthesis — as an MCP server. Hosted mode needs no API keys.
